profile.summary: A for-profit company that provides special inspections, construction materials testing and geotechnical engineering services for building projects in California and Nevada. It was founded in 1994 and has offices in the Bay Area, the Central Valley, the Sacramento area and Las Vegas.

review.notes: Construction Testing Services, Inc. (cts-1.com) does special inspection and materials testing for building projects, which fits OUSD's materials testing and special inspection agreements, and its Contact page lists an Oakland office that matches the agenda's Oakland, CA. The AGC directory and the SAM record agree on the name, Pleasanton address and for-profit California corporation status, and every profile field is supported by a cited page; the summary is neutral and the contact details are generic business ones.
